label: GDP Growth (2025 actual / Q1 2026 preliminary / 2026 forecast)
change: Q1 2026 INEGI preliminary (Apr 30): -0.8% quarterly contraction, +0.2% annual. All sectors declined. Full-year 2026 forecast downgraded: Citi survey May 21 → 1.1%; IMF 1.6%; BBVA 1.8%; govt 1.8–2.8%. USMCA uncertainty and tariff drag cited.
source: INEGI preliminary Q1 2026, April 30; Citi Encuesta de Expectativas, May 21, 2026

label: Annual Inflation
change: -0.34pp vs full April 2026 (4.45%); -0.16pp vs second half April. Fuel price freeze with gas station owners and electricity summer subsidy are key downward drivers. Continued deceleration into Q2 2026.
source: INEGI, first fortnight May 2026 — announced May 22, 2026 mañanera

label: Banxico Policy Rate
change: -475bp from 11.25% peak; 15th consecutive cut (25bp) on May 7, 2026 in 3-2 split vote (Gov. Rodríguez Ceja + Cuadra + Mejía for cut; Borja + Heath for hold). Board guidance signals end of easing cycle. No further cuts expected through 2027.
source: Banco de México press release, May 7, 2026; Bloomberg

label: Peso / USD Rate (MXN)
change: ~17.33 MXN/USD (week of May 22); mild depreciation from ~17.29 (May 8) as USMCA bilateral talks open. Year-end consensus forecast: ~18.0 pesos/dollar (Citi survey May 21). Banxico rate at 6.50% provides carry-trade support.
source: Banxico FIX / Citi Encuesta de Expectativas May 21, 2026

label: Minimum Wage Real Increase (2021–2025)
change: Highest among OECD countries over this period

label: Pemex Total Debt (USD)
change: ~$23B reduction under outgoing director Rodríguez Padilla (Oct 2024–May 14, 2026). New director: Juan Carlos Carpio Fragoso (former CFO), confirmed May 15. First credit outlook upgrade in over a decade.
